title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kpatch-patch-5_14_0-570_116_1, kpatch-patch-5_14_0-570_135_1, kpatch-patch-5_14_0-570_39_1,…
description: This advisory addresses multiple security vulnerabilities in the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 kernel live patch module for kernel version 5.14.0-570.116.1.el9_6. The vulnerabilities include improper validation of DAC offset pointers in SMB client code, improper allocation limits in IPC next_id, a potential use-after-free in UDP tunnel segmentation, and unbounded receive headroom in the network tunnel driver. These issues have been fixed in updated kpatch-patch modules.
